description: Use this when the person asks about one of their own products: its documents, versions, archive, QR link or how many recipients get updates. Returns one product of the connected account: master data, every current document (kind, language, version, revision date, upload date, SHA-256), the version archive with the date each version was superseded, which safety data sheets are older than three years, how many recipients get new versions, the QR link and the dashboard link. Do not use for public products of other manufacturers (use resolve_product).

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

product_id.description: Product id, as list_my_products returns it

name: get_my_product
title: Product with documents and versions
